en: Used to form nouns or adjectives.
Used to form nouns from verbs.
A suffix used on verbs to form masculine words for objects or tools used to do something.
A suffix used on verbs to form masculine words for places where something is done.
A suffix forming infinitives of some verbs.
Suffix used to form adjectives matched to nouns ending in -ation (or its variants) and derived from a Latin verb.
Suffix used on verbs to form feminine nouns, generally referring to objects or tools used to do something.
Suffix used on verbs (usually attached to the Latin supine stem) to form masculine nouns, generally referring to places where something is done.
Used to form adjectives related to a particular country, region or city, their associated inhabitant names, and the local language or dialect
added to a noun to form a diminutive, or a depreciative form of that noun
forms diminutives of things, including some animals
a suffix denoting the first-person plural present indicative form of a verb
-onymous (having a specified number or type of names)
-onym (combining form meaning “word” or “name”, used in terms that denote a particular kind of word or name)
forms the diminutive of certain words; often the meaning changes unpredictably
forms verbs from other verbs or sometimes nouns, with a diminutive or frequentative sense
forms colloquial or slang feminine forms of nouns
a suffix used to form some verbs, often with factitive effect
